chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:

chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。

# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

chunk.text:

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:

chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:

# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

chunk.title: rrf.md

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:

chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。

chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。

# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。

chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。

chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:

chunk.text:

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。

Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:

chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:

chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# Agent Harness

The Harness limits execution steps, tool attempts, model calls and token budgets. Timeouts and bounded retries prevent uncontrolled loops. SDK implicit retries must be disabled when the application owns retry accounting.

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.

网页导入阻断私网与云元数据地址,逐次校验重定向并绑定已验证 IP。工具白名单不包含任意 Shell。
chunk.title: security.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

Agent 执行护栏限制步数、工具次数、模型调用和 Token 预算,超时和有限重试避免无限循环。
chunk.title: harness.md

chunk.text:
# Reciprocal Rank Fusion

RRF merges ranked lists with score sum(1/(k+rank)). KnowledgeOps uses k=60. RRF does not directly add incompatible dense and BM25 raw scores.

RRF 倒数排名融合使用排名而非直接相加原始得分,常数 k 默认等于 60。
chunk.title: rrf.md

chunk.text:
# Document ingestion

Raw SHA-256 hashes support integrity checking. Normalized text defines document identity. PDF page numbers and chunk offsets make source passages inspectable. Scan-only PDFs need OCR.

知识导入保存原文件哈希、规范化文本、PDF 页码和分块偏移。扫描 PDF 需要 OCR。
chunk.title: ingestion.md

chunk.text:
# Observability

Local task events are durable. Optional Langfuse exports operational metadata without prompts or source text by default. A tracing outage must not stop research tasks.

可观测性以本地持久事件为准,Langfuse 可选,追踪服务故障不应阻断研究。
chunk.title: observability.md

chunk.text:
# LangGraph persistence

LangGraph checkpoints graph state at execution boundaries. A stable thread_id identifies a run. Recovery also needs idempotent external operations and persisted budgets.

LangGraph 检查点支持状态持久化和中断恢复,外部副作用仍需幂等处理,预算不能在恢复时重置。
chunk.title: langgraph.md

chunk.text:
# BM25 lexical retrieval

BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. Chinese text needs segmentation. Zero or negative IDF can occur in small corpora.

BM25 关键词检索依赖词频、逆文档频率和长度归一化。中文需要分词,小语料中的 IDF 可能为零或负数。
chunk.title: bm25.md

chunk.text:
# Redis RDB

RDB creates point-in-time snapshots. Data written after the last completed snapshot can be lost. RDB is useful for compact backups and fast loading.

Redis 的 RDB 保存时间点快照,最后一次快照之后的数据存在丢失风险,适合紧凑备份。
chunk.title: redis_rdb.md

chunk.text:
# Qdrant vectors

Qdrant stores dense vectors and payload metadata. Cosine similarity measures vector direction. The embedding dimension must match the collection configuration.

Qdrant 向量数据库支持稠密向量、余弦相似度和来源元数据过滤,向量维度必须匹配集合。
chunk.title: qdrant.md

chunk.text:
# CrossEncoder reranking

A CrossEncoder jointly processes a query and a candidate passage to predict relevance. It reranks an existing candidate set; it cannot recover documents absent from that set.

CrossEncoder 交叉编码器联合编码问题与候选段落进行重排,无法召回候选集合之外的文档。
chunk.title: reranker.md

chunk.text:
# Redis AOF

AOF (Append Only File) records Redis write commands. The appendfsync everysec policy can lose about one second of writes after a crash. AOF rewrite compacts the log.

Redis 的 AOF 追加日志记录写命令。每秒刷盘策略在崩溃时可能丢失约一秒写入,重写用于压缩日志。
chunk.title: redis_aof.md

chunk.text:
Retrieval evaluation uses relevance judgments. Recall@K is the fraction of relevant documents in the first K results. MRR@10 uses the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document up to rank ten. P50 and P95 summarize query latency.

召回评测需要相关性标注。Recall 衡量相关文档覆盖,MRR 衡量首个相关结果排名,P50 和 P95 衡量延迟分位数。
chunk.title: metrics.txt

chunk.text:
# Safe web import

Web import accepts only public HTTP and HTTPS pages. Validate every redirect, reject private addresses, and pin connections to validated IPs to prevent DNS rebinding. Agent tools must be allowlisted.
